artifacts.notes: Contains the finite-sum left-endpoint theorem, terminal constant and compactified-momentum exclusions, polynomial vanishing-factor theorem, two-node determinant, rational entropy vector, and dependency-only Petrov/analytic ledgers. The mandatory loop was self-discover, step-back, metacognitive assumption audit, CoVe by independent corollaries/exact vectors, adversarial distinct-space steelman, claim-keyed dependency audit, and PDR.

findings.statement: PASS for NC-SAME-SPACE under its exact assumptions. Lean proves that every finite real linear combination of basis functions tending to zero as xi approaches 1 from below also tends to zero, and therefore cannot equal either 1 or p_star*xi/(1-xi) on any nonempty terminal interval when p_star>0. It also proves lim_(xi->1-) (1-xi)q(xi)=0 for every real polynomial q. Strongest opposing steelman: a distinct conservative test space containing 1 and p, or an analytic invariant component, is outside the same-space theorem and is not rejected by it. The decisive falsifier would have to violate a stated hypothesis: finiteness, xi-independent finite coefficients, terminal vanishing of every trial basis function, or pointwise terminal-interval equality.
assumptions_used: The index set used in the expansion is finite.
Coefficients are finite real constants independent of xi.
Each trial basis function tends to zero along nhdsWithin 1 (Iio 1).
Exact representation means pointwise equality on Ioo a 1 for some a<1.
For the momentum exclusion p_star>0, hence p_star is nonzero, and 1-xi is nonzero on Ioo a 1.
Real topology is Hausdorff and the left-neighborhood filter at 1 is nontrivial.
